column1: # Units: US dollars per million tokens. Columns are tab-separated:
# model, provider, variant, input, output, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h, cache_read, source_url, checked_on
# model is the id exactly as the harness logs it. provider is "anthropic" for Claude Code,
# or the OpenCode providerID; "*" matches any provider. variant is standard, fast or over100k.
# A "-" means no charge for that kind of token. OpenCode messages that store a non-zero
# cost use that stored cost; the OpenCode rows here only price messages that store
# cost 0 (free models, subscriptions), at list rate. See AD-014.
